errors._review_note: v1.0.3 audit: rider-facing API error messages.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: No connection. Check your internet and try again — it is safe to retry.
errors.timeout: The server took too long to answer. Try again — it is safe to retry.
errors.server: HudHud is having a problem right now. Please try again in a moment.
errors.too_many: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.session_expired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.exchange_rate_missing: This job cannot be settled yet because an exchange rate is missing. Support has been alerted. Nothing was charged — try completing again in a few minutes.
errors.city_mismatch: This request is in another city. You can only take requests in your own city.
errors.dispatch_offer_required: HudHud assigns this order automatically. Stay online — if it is for you, it will appear as an offer on your screen.
errors.job_gone: This job is no longer available.
errors.not_eligible: Your account cannot take orders right now. Check your account status or contact support.
errors.cod_settlement_balance: Your wallet balance is too low to settle this cash order. Top up your wallet, then complete again.
errors.active_job: Finish your current job before accepting another one.
errors.handover_code_required: Enter the recipient's handover code first.
errors.parcel_stops_pending: Some drop-offs are not finished yet. Complete or mark each stop before closing the parcel.
errors.parcel_use_stops: This parcel has several drop-offs. Use the stop list to deliver each one.
errors.parcel_stop_out_of_order: Deliver the stops in order. Finish the current stop first.
errors.delivery_photo_required: Take a photo of the delivered parcel before completing.
errors.pickup_cash_required: Collect the cash from the sender and confirm it before starting the trip.
errors.proof_limit: Photo limit reached for this step.
errors.proof_not_now: A photo cannot be added at this step.
errors.proof_unavailable: Photo uploads are not available right now. Continue the delivery and tell support.
errors.parcel_fail_not_allowed: Only a picked-up parcel can be marked as not delivered.
errors.parcel_return_not_allowed: Only a failed parcel can be marked as returned.
errors.collection_required: Collect the payment (cash or electronic) before closing this delivery.
errors.withdrawals_on_hold: Withdrawals are temporarily on hold. Your balance is safe. Please contact HudHud support.
errors.cancel_needs_support: The parcel is already picked up. Contact support to cancel or return it.
errors.status_changed: This job's status changed. Pull to refresh to see the latest.
errors.finish_before_offline: Finish your current delivery before going offline, so the customer can still track you.
